title: Listening Drill — Library reader
description: Customer service dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Library reader
sections.transcript:
CUSTOMER: I need some help with an electronic reader. The main problem is the screen freezes. I thought I could solve it myself, but the instructions don't cover what I've seen.

ADVISER: We can look into it. First please send the error message. Then bring the item to the library desk. If you go to the original collection point they will send you back here.

CUSTOMER: What happens if you can't sort it out while I'm there?

ADVISER: Ask for a loan extension. remember to show your user card. Keep the confirmation until the issue has been closed.
